entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was a sunny, beautiful day in Ja..."
entries.dialogueText: It was a sunny, beautiful day in Jales. From the tall windows of the hilltop mansion where I was staying, I saw Brenas locals frolicking on the beach beneath colorful umbrellas.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "At least Pabel had managed to sourc..."
entries.dialogueText: At least Pabel had managed to source a bottle of very rare champagne for me, as well as a golden saber to open it with.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I sighed, longing for the sun and t..."
entries.dialogueText: I sighed, longing for the sun and the sand. Instead, I was cooped up in a small room with my councilors.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""It is about to begin, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "It is about to begin, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Laurento came before me, bowed and..."
entries.dialogueText: Laurento came before me, bowed and gestured towards the antique sofa in front of the television.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He was referring to the Zille refer..."
entries.dialogueText: He was referring to the Zille referendum. The event that would determine the future of our northernmost region, and the reason we were all inside on this gorgeous day.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you for letting me know, Lau..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for letting me know, Laurento."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I moved to the sofa."
entries.dialogueText: I moved to the sofa.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita bowed and sat down beside me..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita bowed and sat down beside me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Taddeus bowed and moved his wheelch..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus bowed and sat down next to me..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus bowed and sat down next to me.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I turned on the television."
entries.dialogueText: I turned on the television.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The ballot boxes were only 18% open..."
entries.dialogueText: The ballot boxes were only 18% open. It was too early to say anything yet. We had to wait.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""What are your thoughts, Your Majes..."
entries.dialogueText: "What are your thoughts, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Zille will vote to return to Rizia..."
entries.dialogueText: "Zille will vote to return to Rizia. I can't see this going any other way."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If the will of the people is to re..."
entries.dialogueText: "If the will of the people is to remain a part of Wehlen, I will respect that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will see Zille return to Rizia...."
entries.dialogueText: "I will see Zille return to Rizia. By any means possible."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel

entries.dialogueText: "My worry is that this 'will' is being manipulated by Wehlen, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Not without a massive manipulation..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not without a massive manipulation effort by Wehlen. Which is, I'm sorry to say, entirely possible."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""There are options. I am sure.""
entries.dialogueText: "There are options. I am sure."
